scope: One bounded controlled-window pixel-origin preflight;no product/full build,no physical media or shared-desktop capture
environment: Existing Windows10 guest,Agents coordinator,owned restricted child,existing512MiB cap and one managed campaign
positive_controls: Independently specify exact RGB tile locations/colors from a per-run challenge before drawing;the capture helper receives only the owned window identity.
Capture pattern A,then pattern B through the same HWND/PID/desktop and dimensions;both actual payloads must match their independently expected RGB samples and differ as specified.
Retain bounded source/producer/fixture identities,actual pixel hashes and direct visual review of the produced image.
negative_controls: Wrong-surface or stale-A pixels with otherwise consistent B receipts must fail.
Keep wrong job/image/desktop/nonce/dimensions and mutating-open refusals.
A capture API success or nonuniform/color count alone cannot pass.
boundaries: The invalidated GetWindowDC route remains disabled.

Any visible desktop use requires owned-surface exclusivity,explicit observation of guest input inactivity,and restoration in finally;do not sample the shared desktop or interfere with concurrent users.
Do not enlarge storage budgets,alter worker/product-record ACLs,reboot the guest or run a product/full rebuild before this preflight passes.
completion: Actual independently expected owned-window pixels and wrong-surface refusal,verified cleanup,and an explicit method admission review. A successful control alone does not qualify product images.
capture_method_selected: Control-only PrintWindow rendering into a memory DIB through explicit WM_PRINT/WM_PRINTCLIENT;no display DC read or desktop switch.
authority: Existing bounded guest-development grant;this plan creates no new privilege.

pixel_recipe.window: Owned borderless popup with no child controls;client/window bounds must both match240x96.
pixel_recipe.challenge: Coordinator chooses16 random bytes before drawing;the capture helper does not receive the color recipe/challenge.
pixel_recipe.rgb: For tile i=0..15 and phase p=0 or1,use the first3 bytes of SHA256(ASCII DiskEd pixel-origin/1 followed by NUL,the16 challenge bytes,the one-byte phase,the one-byte tile index),in R,G,B order.
pixel_recipe.comparison: Verify all23040 RGB pixels exactly for each phase;ignore only unused DIB alpha. Transform/cropping cannot be inferred from observed colors. Require distinct phase payload hashes.
pixel_recipe.wrong_surface: A correctly framed/digested stale phase-A payload cannot pass phase B;an all-zero or synthetic unrelated surface cannot pass either phase.
pixel_recipe.no_adaptive_expectations: Fix dimensions,recipe,challenge,expected full RGB buffers and target phase before capture;never change them in response to observed output.
